shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, menus, screens, cups, clothes or bags.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.pair: Only these two people are in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.stairs: The place is the inside of a bright, tidy two-story family house in the daytime. The camera stands downstairs in the front hallway and looks at a straight wooden staircase that rises from the hallway floor to an open upstairs landing with a white wooden banister. The whole staircase, the hallway floor at its foot and the upstairs landing are all clearly visible in the photo, so it is obvious at a glance whether a person is upstairs or downstairs.
shared_prompts.edit: Edit Image 1. Keep the place, the furniture, the light, the colors and the camera position exactly the same; change only what is described below.
shared_prompts.nobody: There are no people anywhere in the photo.
shared_prompts.evening: It is evening: the window shows a dark blue sky.

assets.item: Luna is in front of the sofa.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Sofia's cat Luna, a grey-and-brown tabby with a white chest and white paws. Keep the cat exactly; Sofia is not in this photo. Create a new photograph of a bright living room seen straight from the front. A light-grey sofa stands in the middle of the room, about one meter away from the back wall. To the right of the sofa stands a tall floor lamp, with a clear gap of about one meter of empty floor between the lamp and the sofa. Luna sits on the wooden floor IN FRONT OF the sofa, in the middle, closer to the camera than the sofa, fully visible, looking at the camera. The lamp is off.

reference_file.observed_description: Sofia in her blue blazer kneels by a round grey cat bed in her bright living room, where her cat Luna, a grey-and-brown tabby with a white chest and white paws, lies curled up (A1+ 1.10).

assets.prompt: Move Luna BEHIND the sofa: she is now on the far side of the sofa, between the sofa and the back wall, and only her head and her two front paws show over the top of the sofa's backrest as she peeks at the camera; the sofa hides the rest of her body. The floor in front of the sofa is now empty.

assets.item: Luna is between the lamp and the sofa.
assets.prompt: Move Luna: she now sits on the floor in the gap BETWEEN the lamp and the sofa, fully visible, with the sofa on one side of her and the lamp on the other, looking at the camera. The floor in front of the sofa is now empty.

assets.item: Max is in front of the tree.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Luis's dog Max, a short-haired tan dog with a white chest and floppy ears. Keep the dog exactly; Luis is not in this photo, and Max has no ball. Create a new photograph of a sunny park: one big old tree with a very thick trunk, much wider than the dog, stands in the middle of the photo on the grass. Max sits on the grass IN FRONT OF the tree, between the trunk and the camera, fully visible, looking at the camera.

reference_file.observed_description: Luis in a navy T-shirt crouches on the grass of a sunny park and pets his dog Max, a short-haired tan dog with a white chest and floppy ears, holding a yellow ball in his mouth (A1+ 1.10).

assets.prompt: Move Max BEHIND the tree: he is now on the far side of the thick trunk, and only his head and one front paw peek out from the right side of the trunk; the trunk hides the rest of him. The grass in front of the tree is now empty.
